detailZh: 2026年卡塔尔F1大奖赛：开始时间、赛程和观看方式
2026年美国地区2026年F1卡塔尔大奖赛开始时间，以及完整的赛程和如何在Apple TV上观看直播
乔治·拉塞尔驾驶梅赛德斯F1 W15领先，排在马克斯·维斯塔潘驾驶的雷诺车队小红牛20、兰多·诺里斯驾驶的迈凯轮MCL38、奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂驾驶的迈凯轮MCL38以及其他车手起跑位置
卡塔尔大奖赛于11月29日星期日早上8点PT开始，即东部时间上午11点。一级方程式赛车重返卢塞尔国际赛道，进行2026赛季倒数第二场比赛，所有练习与排位赛均在Apple TV上直播。完整的赛程和观看信息如下。
在阿拉斯加，每场练习的开始时间比PT列中的时间早一个小时，而在夏威夷则早两个小时。这并不是一个短距离周末。
卡塔尔大奖赛什么时候开始？
卡塔尔大奖赛将于11月29日星期日早上8点PT时间，9点MT时间，10点CT时间和11点ET时间开始。在阿拉斯加，比赛将在早上7点开始，而在夏威夷则是早上6点。
比赛将在3.367英里长的卢塞尔国际赛道上进行57圈，总里程为191.8英里。如果没有中断，比赛应该在PT时间上午9:30左右结束，ET时间中午12:30左右结束。
卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛是什么时候？
排位赛将于11月28日星期六上午10点PT时间、上午11点MT时间、中午12点CT时间和下午1点ET时间开始。最慢的五位车手在Q1中被淘汰，另外五位在Q2中被淘汰，剩下10位车手在Q3中争夺杆位。
卢塞尔赛道以中高速弯道为主，长的流畅段落会给轮胎带来很大的负荷。长的起终点直道提供了赛道上最清晰的超车机会。
如何在美观看卡塔尔大奖赛
$14.99每月，包含七天免费试用期
每一场一级方程式赛事直播，包括F1 TV Premium服务
卡塔尔赛事中有什么在争夺？
基米·安东内利已经锁定了2026年的车手总冠军，梅赛德斯赢得了车队总冠军，但在剩余两场比赛中，第二名的争夺仍然开放。
马克斯·维斯塔潘以304分领先这场争夺战，他在拉斯维加斯获胜。刘易斯·汉密尔顿以267分位居第二，乔治·罗素和兰多·诺里斯并列264分。在卡塔尔和阿布扎比还有50分可供争夺，所有四名车手都有可能获得第二名。
法拉利车队以517分位居车队总冠军第二位，领先于积分为440分的红牛车队和积分为431分的麦凯轮车队。红牛车队和麦凯轮车队在争夺第三名的比赛中仅相差九分。
卢塞尔国际赛道全长3.367英里，是一条快速流畅的永久赛道，以中高速弯角为主。其长的主直道通向一号弯的主超车机会，而宽阔的弯角对轮胎施加持续的负荷。
卡塔尔大奖赛在灯光下进行，比赛当地时间晚上7点开始。
谁赢得了2025年的卡塔尔大奖赛？
马克斯·维斯塔潘在2025年卡塔尔大奖赛中获胜，领先奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂和卡洛斯·塞恩斯。皮亚斯蒂从杆位起跑，代表麦克拉伦车队。
维斯塔潘赢得了过去三年中的每一场卡塔尔大奖赛，分别在2023年、2024年和2025年夺冠。
卡塔尔大奖赛：常见问题
美国时间卡塔尔大奖赛何时开始？
11月29日星期日，上午8点太平洋时间（PT），上午9点山地时间（MT），上午10点中部时间（CT）和上午11点东部时间（ET）。
卡塔尔大奖赛的排位赛何时进行？
周六，11月28日，上午10点太平洋时间/下午1点东部时间。

Apple TV是美国Formula 1的独家播出平台，并提供卡塔尔站的现场直播。

没有。2026年的周末有三场练习赛、排位赛和大奖赛。

detailEn: F1 Qatar GP 2026: start time, schedule and how to watch
What time the 2026 F1 Qatar Grand Prix starts across the US, plus the full schedule and how to watch live on Apple TV
George Russell, Mercedes F1 W15, leads Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing RB20, Lando Norris, McLaren MCL38, Oscar Piastri, McLaren MCL38, and the rest of the field at the start

The Qatar Grand Prix starts at 8 am PT on Sunday, November 29, which is 11 am ET. Formula 1 returns to the Lusail International Circuit for the penultimate race of the 2026 season, with every session live on Apple TV. The full schedule and viewing information are below.
In Alaska every session starts one hour earlier than in the PT column, and in Hawaii two hours earlier. This is not a sprint weekend.
What time does the Qatar Grand Prix start?
The Qatar Grand Prix starts on Sunday, November 29, at 8 am PT, 9 am MT, 10 am CT and 11 am ET. In Alaska it starts at 7 am, and in Hawaii at 6 am.
The race runs over 57 laps of the 3.367-mile Lusail International Circuit, covering 191.8 miles. Without interruptions it should finish at around 9:30 am PT, 12:30 pm ET.
What time is Qatar GP qualifying?

Qualifying starts on Saturday, November 28, at 10 am PT, 11 am MT, 12 pm CT and 1 pm ET. The slowest five drivers are eliminated in Q1 and another five in Q2, leaving 10 to fight for pole position in Q3.

Lusail is dominated by medium- and high-speed corners, with long, flowing sections putting significant load through the tires. The long start-finish straight provides the circuit's clearest overtaking opportunity.
How to watch the Qatar Grand Prix in the US

Apple TV holds the exclusive US rights to Formula 1 and shows every session live. Every practice session can be watched free without a subscription, while qualifying and the Qatar Grand Prix require an Apple TV subscription.
$14.99 a month after a seven-day free trial
Every F1 session live, with F1 TV Premium included
What is at stake in Qatar?
Kimi Antonelli has already secured the 2026 drivers' championship and Mercedes has won the constructors' title, but the fight for second place remains open with two races remaining.

Max Verstappen leads that battle on 304 points after winning in Las Vegas. Lewis Hamilton is next on 267, with George Russell and Lando Norris tied on 264. With 50 points still available across Qatar and Abu Dhabi, all four can still finish runner-up.
Ferrari is second in the constructors' championship on 517 points, ahead of Red Bull on 440 and McLaren on 431. Red Bull and McLaren are separated by just nine points in the fight for third.

The 3.367-mile Lusail International Circuit is a fast, flowing permanent circuit dominated by medium- and high-speed corners. Its long main straight leads into the primary overtaking opportunity at Turn 1, while the sweeping corners place sustained loads on the tires.
The Qatar Grand Prix takes place under floodlights, with the race beginning at 7 pm local time.
Who won the Qatar Grand Prix in 2025?
Max Verstappen won the 2025 Qatar Grand Prix ahead of Oscar Piastri and Carlos Sainz. Piastri started from pole for McLaren.
Verstappen has won each of the last three Qatar Grands Prix, taking victory in 2023, 2024 and 2025.
Qatar Grand Prix: frequently asked questions
What time does the Qatar Grand Prix start in the US?
Sunday, November 29, at 8 am PT, 9 am MT, 10 am CT and 11 am ET.
What time is Qatar Grand Prix qualifying?
Saturday, November 28, at 10 am PT and 1 pm ET.
What channel is the Qatar Grand Prix on?
Apple TV is the exclusive US home of Formula 1 and streams the Qatar Grand Prix live.
Can I watch the Qatar Grand Prix for free?

Practice sessions are free on Apple TV without a subscription. The Qatar Grand Prix has not been announced as one of Apple's free race weekends, so a subscription is required for qualifying and the race.
Is there a sprint race at the Qatar Grand Prix?
No. The 2026 weekend has three practice sessions, qualifying and the Grand Prix.
How many laps is the Qatar Grand Prix?
The race is 57 laps of the 3.367-mile Lusail International Circuit, covering 191.8 miles.

detailEn: F1 Qatar GP 2026: UK times, schedule and how to watch
What time the 2026 F1 Qatar Grand Prix starts in the UK, plus the full schedule and how to watch live on Sky Sports F1 and NOW

The Qatar Grand Prix starts at 4pm UK time on Sunday 29 November. Formula 1 returns to the Lusail International Circuit for the penultimate race of the 2026 season, with every session live on Sky Sports F1. The full UK schedule and viewing information are below.
Qatar Grand Prix 2026 schedule in UK time
Qatar is three hours ahead of the UK. This is not a sprint weekend.
What time does the Qatar Grand Prix start in the UK?
The Qatar Grand Prix starts at 4pm UK time on Sunday 29 November. The race runs over 57 laps of the 5.419km (3.367-mile) Lusail International Circuit, covering 308.611km (191.8 miles).
Without interruptions, the race should finish at around 5:30pm UK time. If it runs beyond two hours, the chequered flag will fall before all 57 laps are completed.
What time is qualifying for the Qatar Grand Prix?
Qualifying starts at 6pm UK time on Saturday 28 November and lasts about an hour. The slowest five drivers are eliminated in Q1 and another five in Q2, leaving 10 to fight for pole position in Q3.

Lusail is dominated by medium and high-speed corners, with long, flowing sections putting significant load through the tyres. The long start-finish straight provides the circuit's clearest overtaking opportunity.
How to watch the Qatar Grand Prix in the UK

Sky Sports F1 shows every session live. Without a Sky TV subscription, the same coverage is available through NOW. Channel 4 will show free highlights of qualifying at 9:30pm on Saturday and the race at 9pm on Sunday.

Kimi Antonelli has already secured the 2026 drivers' championship and Mercedes has won the constructors' title, but the fight for second place remains open with two races remaining.

Max Verstappen leads that battle on 304 points after winning in Las Vegas. Lewis Hamilton is second among the chasing group on 267, with George Russell and Lando Norris tied on 264. With 50 points still available across Qatar and Abu Dhabi, all four can still finish runner-up.
Ferrari is second in the constructors' championship on 517 points, ahead of Red Bull on 440 and McLaren on 431. Red Bull and McLaren are separated by just nine points in the fight for third.

The 5.419km Lusail International Circuit is a fast, flowing permanent circuit dominated by medium- and high-speed corners. Its long main straight leads into the primary overtaking opportunity at Turn 1, while the sequence of sweeping corners places sustained loads on the tyres.
The Qatar Grand Prix takes place under floodlights, with the race beginning at 7pm local time.
Who won the Qatar Grand Prix in 2025?
Max Verstappen won the 2025 Qatar Grand Prix ahead of Oscar Piastri and Carlos Sainz. Oscar Piastri started from pole for McLaren.
Verstappen has won each of the last three Qatar Grands Prix, taking victory in 2023, 2024 and 2025.

detailZh: 汉密尔顿：法拉利在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛的极速劣势“残酷”
汉密尔顿对SF-26在内华达街道赛道直道上缺乏速度感到震惊
法拉利F1车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示，SF-26在拉斯维加斯长直道上的极速劣势暴露得比他预想的更加“残酷”。
汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔均在Q2被淘汰，正赛最终分别以第七和第十名完赛，他们各自的10秒罚时浪费了潜在的成绩——其中勒克莱尔因与队友相撞被罚，这让情况更加不利。
法拉利的实际速度比排位赛中更好——他们在比赛的大部分时间里都保持在距离领先者五秒以内——但汉密尔顿认为，随着F1中“拉锯式”的竞争回归，他们缺乏直线速度的代价很大。
“我们知道我们在直道上存在速度劣势，但我们没想到在这里这些长直道上会如此残酷，”这位英国车手评论道。
“始终确保你跟在车后很重要，而试图向前推进时，你总是必须确保自己在尾流中。否则，你就只是周围人的活靶子。
“梅赛德斯和红牛，他们在直线上的动力令人印象深刻。真的非常令人印象深刻。
“我的引擎已经到极限了，没有更多动力可输出了。我拼命按按钮，想完成超车。”
汉密尔顿在比赛中的最高速度为316.7公里/小时，有趣的是，这比领跑的勒克莱尔的330.1公里/小时慢了13.4公里/小时，而梅赛德斯和红牛的最高速度分别为320.6公里/小时和314.3公里/小时。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
“我已经拼尽全力，为拿到这些积分付出了一切。我们不断遭遇挑战。我只是保持专注，”这位法拉利车手补充道，随后回应了他因离开赛道并获得优势而受到的处罚。
“十秒罚时太离谱了，而且非常非常严厉，”他这样认为。“我当时是在避免撞上迈凯伦。他们本可以直接让我把位置还回去。十秒的停车罚时简直疯了。
“但我回来了，重新投入了战斗，我能看到前面的马克斯。”法拉利的速度就是这么不错，但在他的车手再次相撞之后，车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔却很难看到任何积极之处。
“我不想说速度好还是怎样，因为对我来说今天这无关紧要，”这位法国人严厉地评论道。“当然，当我们回来并超越了迈凯伦等等，我有一种积极的感觉。但老实说，这不是我桌上要讨论的话题。
补充报道来自吉汉吉尔·佩尔佩里克和罗纳德·沃丁。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari’s top-speed deficit was “brutal” at F1 Las Vegas GP
Hamilton was shocked by the SF-26’s lack of velocity on straights at the Nevadan street circuit
Ferrari Formula 1 driver Lewis Hamilton says the SF-26’s top-speed deficit was exposed as even more “brutal” than he expected on Las Vegas’ long straights.

Hamilton and Charles Leclerc were both eliminated in Q2 and finished the race down in seventh and 10th, with their potential squandered by a 10-second penalty for each – including one inflicted on Leclerc for colliding with his team-mate, which didn’t help matters.

Ferrari’s actual pace was better than in qualifying – they stayed within five seconds of the race leader for most of the race – but Hamilton felt their lack of straightline speed was costly as ‘yo-yo’ racing returned to F1.
“We knew that we have a pace deficit on the straights, but we weren't expecting it to be so brutal here with these long straights,” the Briton commented.
“It was important always to make sure you're behind the car, and trying to move forwards you always have to make sure you're in a tow. Otherwise, you're just a sitting duck to people around.
“The Mercedes and the Red Bull, their power on a straight line is impressive. Really impressive.
“My engine was on the limit, there was nothing else coming out. I was pressing the button as hard as I could to make moves.”
Hamilton’s top speed in the race was 316.7km/h, interestingly 13.4km/h down on pacesetting Leclerc’s 330.1km/h, while the top Mercedes and Red Bull were on 320.6km/h and 314.3km/h respectively.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

“I've fought as hard as I can and given everything I could to get those points today. We were just constantly hit with challenges. I just kept my head down,” the Ferrari driver added, before reacting to his penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage.
“Ten seconds was insane and very, very harsh,” he reckoned. “I was avoiding colliding with the McLaren. They could have just told me to give the place back. Ten seconds to stop and go is nuts.

“But I came back and I got back into the fight and I could see Max up ahead.” That’s how decent Ferrari’s pace was, but team principal Fred Vasseur was struggling to see any positives after his drivers collided yet again.

“I don't want to say that the pace was good or whatever, because for me today it’s anecdotic,” the Frenchman sternly commented. “For sure, when we came back and we overtook McLaren and so, I had a positive feeling. But honestly, it's not the topic on my desk.”
Additional reporting by Cihangir Perperik and Ronald Vording

items.originalTitle: Guenther Steiner warns George Russell: Do not "poke the bear" Max Verstappen
detailZh: 格涅特·斯特尼尔警告乔治·拉塞尔：不要"激怒熊"马克斯·维斯塔潘
前哈斯车队负责人格涅特·斯特尼尔表示，拉塞尔选择了一场他无法赢得的战斗，在拉斯维加斯与维斯塔潘的口水战中。
马克斯·维斯塔潘、小红牛、乔治·拉塞尔、梅赛德斯
对于梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯顿的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析。
前哈斯一级方程式车队负责人古恩特·斯特尼尔敦促梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔不要在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上与马克斯·维斯塔潘"激怒熊"，因为在比赛中的言语冲突。
拉塞尔在最后一场练习赛中与维斯塔潘发生碰撞后，抨击这位红牛车手四处走动时"好像他们比所有人都大、都好"，并表示"有人必须站出来对抗这个人"。
随后，两人在拉斯维加斯大道的比赛中不断互换领先，直到英国人在第48圈试图超越队友基米·安东内利时锁死方向盘撞上墙壁。维斯塔潘获胜，并在赛后表示拉塞尔"远远低于我的水平"。
在《红旗播客》上发言时，斯特尼尔表示他不介意两位车手互相不喜欢，但质疑拉塞尔为何选择挑战维斯塔潘。
“不，我的意思是，我对这没有问题，因为最终，如果他们彼此不喜欢，我为什么要关心呢？”斯泰纳说。
他们之间已经这样很久了，显然，乔治出来发表声明，'哦，这个人非常傲慢'，或者他关于马克斯说的话，'有人需要站出来反对他'。是的，祝你好运，伙计。看看这是怎么收场的。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
前车队负责人表示，他尊重拉塞尔作为车手的能力，但他低估了维斯塔潘的心理素质。
“我尊重乔治作为一名赛车手，但最终，马克斯在心理上更胜一筹。在如何处理心理问题上，他比你强得多，不要去招惹熊，在我看来，”他说。
“没有必要这样做，因为你不会对自己有任何好处。放下吧。试着赢得比赛，而不是与那里的最佳车手，最强的心理战高手战斗，因为你知道吗？你只会输，”
“就像没有人坐下来对他说，‘乔治，有时候少即是多。什么都不说，做好自己的工作，’”斯泰纳说，并补充说梅赛德斯车手应该专注于赢得比赛。
“然后当你有话要说，因为打败了那个人时，再选择你的战斗。但正如我说的，如果你不能打败他们，就加入他们，在那个时刻，只是闭嘴，继续前进。”
维斯塔潘的胜利使他进一步领先，在车手积分榜上以304分排名第二。拉塞尔以第九名的成绩结束比赛，以264分排在第四位，落后于刘易斯·汉密尔顿。
detailEn: Guenther Steiner warns George Russell: Do not "poke the bear" Max Verstappen
The former Haas boss says Russell picked a fight he cannot win, after the Mercedes driver's war of words with Verstappen in Las Vegas
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has urged Mercedes driver George Russell not to "poke the bear" with Max Verstappen, after their war of words at the Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Russell hit out at Verstappen after the pair clashed in final practice, saying the Red Bull driver walks around "like they're bigger and better than everyone else" and that "somebody's got to stand up to that guy".

The pair then swapped the lead repeatedly during the race on the Las Vegas Strip, until the Briton locked up and hit the wall on lap 48 while trying to pass team-mate Kimi Antonelli for second. Verstappen won, and afterwards said Russell was "so far below my level".
Speaking on The Red Flags Podcast, Steiner said he did not mind the two drivers disliking each other, but questioned why Russell had chosen to take Verstappen on.
"No, I mean, I haven't got a problem with it, because in the end, if they don't like each other, what do I care?" Steiner said.

"This has been going on for a long time between them, and obviously, George coming out to say, 'Oh, this guy behaves very arrogantly', or whatever he said about Max, and 'Somebody needs to stand up to him.' Yeah, good luck with that one, buddy. You see how that worked out."
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
The former team chief said he respected Russell as a driver, but felt he had underestimated Verstappen's mental strength.
"I respect George as a race car driver, but in the end, Max is just mentally superior. On how to manage mental things, he's so superior to you, do not poke the bear, in my opinion," he said.

"There is no need for it, because you don't do yourself any favours. Get over it. Try to win races instead of picking a battle with the best driver out there, the strongest mental guy out there, because guess what? You're going to lose.

"It's like there's nobody sitting down with him and saying, 'George, sometimes less is more. Just say nothing, do your own job,'" Steiner said, adding that the Mercedes driver should focus on winning races.
"And then when you have got something to say because you beat the guy, pick your battle then. But as I said, if you cannot beat them, join them, and in the moment just shut up and get on with it."
Verstappen's win moved him further clear in second place in the drivers' standings on 304 points. Russell, who finished ninth, is fourth on 264, behind Lewis Hamilton.
